items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again

extra.evidence: I’ve been self-hosting things for many years. There were times when I was quite enthusiastic about it, constantly trying out new software and tinkering with my infrastructure. But at some point, that enthusiasm faded a bit. I never really stopped self-hosting, but I became less inclined to experiment with new things. And, somewhat ironically, AI is a big reason for that. items.title: AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp

extra.evidence: Miscellaneous bits and bobs from the tech world tl;dr — I recommend using llama-cpp-rdna-boosts if you have an AMD graphics card. It’s lean, and increased my token generation from 35 to 55 tokens/second, and my prefill from 700 to 1300 tokens per second. YMMV. As of November 2026, an explosion in the number of bespoke inference engines has taken place. Many of them take inspiration from the engines that enabled much of the LLM inference up 'til now: llama.cpp, SGLang, vLLM, etc. The rationale isn’t that those options are bad, but merely that they are generalist engines, optimized for no particular hardware and with a focus on broad compatibility. Others feel the development pace of those engines have slowed down, and with the help of LLMs, they can move faster on their own. Some examples…

items.title: 刚刚，首个带跨任务空间记忆的原生基模开源！机器人端侧就能跑
items.summary: 地图能随时修，记忆能跨任务用

extra.evidence: 地图能随时修，记忆能跨任务用 地下停车场巡检两公里，哪怕每百米只偏半米，一路累积回到起点地图就错位十米；明明是同一根立柱却出现两次，后续定位导航全都乱套。 接到第一个指令，机器人走遍整个办公室，终于找到了角落里的打印机。第二回，要找的打印机明明上一次路过时就见过，机器人却毫无印象，又一次从头找起。 很明显，左边的画面里，一路累积的漂移在模型自纠偏之后，前后拍到的通道对得更齐了。右边的机器人换了任务，依旧能调用之前的三块局部空间记忆。 而且！无一例外，都是把空间记忆直接打包塞进了机器人通用大脑，也就是蚂蚁一直讲的 具身原生 。 好处也很明显， 「一回生二回熟」 ，机器人干活更高效了，还能像人一样端上铁饭碗，同一个地方能一直干下去。 就连SLAM领域的泰斗级人物、帝国理工学院教授Andrew Davison 都亲自下场点赞—— Looks impressive！ 但 缺点也有 ，这样跑实在太依赖前期准备了。。。换个地点、目标，原来的通道和点位就得跟着变。 单个RGB摄像头不停送来画面，模型同步估出相机的位置、朝向和画面中物体的深度，再把看到的空间接起来。 今年4月开源的 LingBot-Map 1.0 已经可以做到，走出去一小段，地图也能跟着往前画。 难就难在怎么把这一段和下一段接起来，还不出错。要是初始位置就估偏了，后面的画面也会沿用这个参照，误差就可能大到从轨迹和点云里看出来。 以CLoSeR为例，系统先通过地点检索找到可能的重访位置，再用这些关联做位姿图优化，把轨迹校正过来。 还是有点麻烦，而且这个方案有一大弊病： 它并不会修正模型内部的空间记忆 ，机器人继续行进时依旧会基于这份已经产生偏差的记忆做出错误判断。 顺着相机走过的轨迹看，博物馆的同一片展厅被前后拍到了好几次。在纠偏前，局部点云的观测有些错位，重新估计后，又 实时对齐 了。 这就是LingBot-Map 2.…

items.title: Kimi 向科学家提供最高 2 万美元 API 免费额度
items.summary: Kimi 大模型开发商月之暗面宣布了 Kimi for Science 项目，欢迎自然科学、工程学及相关交叉学科领域的研究人员加入。月之暗面表示，“科学始终源于人类的好奇心、严谨的探索精神，以及对未知世界的不懈追求。一个有价值的科学假设，往往需要经过大量的文献调研、数据分析和反复验证。而一次意料之外的发现，也可能成为下一项重大突破的起点。然而受限于时间、算力与人力资源，许多值得深入探索的想法，始终未能获得应有的关注与投入。我们相信 AI 能加速科学研究，拓展探索与发现的边界，帮助研究者突破时间、资源与研究方法的局限，让更多大胆而富有想象力的科学构想从可能走向现实。”月之暗面将向入选的研究人员提供最高 20,000 美元的 Kimi API 额度（约 70 亿 token），具体金额将根据研究需求及评估结果确定。

items.title: llamaindex/OCRia-nano-1
Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
items.summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is curren…

items.title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
items.summary: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose , employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an O(T) upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval. Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.
items.title_zh: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2：理解并缓解循环状态不稳定性
items.summary_zh: Gated DeltaNet-2在长上下文训练中容易出现失败。本文提出了一种改进方法，通过对称擦除和衰减调节的残差写入来确保状态传播的非扩张性。实验显示，该方法在~1.6B参数模型上实现了稳定训练，并提升了长上下文检索性能。

items.title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet 256times256, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).
items.title_zh: DyLoMo-DiT：动态循环混合专家扩散Transformer
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种动态循环混合专家扩散Transformer，通过重复应用中间层而非增加参数来扩展模型容量。该方法在保持参数和计算预算的同时，显著降低了FID分数。在文本到图像生成任务中，DyLoMo-DiT的GenEval得分高于FLUX.1。

items.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
items.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstractin…
items.title_zh: 重新审视LLM作为上下文工程师
items.summary_zh: 本文旨在探究LLM作为上下文工程师在数据中构建有效上下文的能力。研究通过建立包含不同推理模式的基准数据集，对比了多种LLM上下文工程方法。结果显示，不存在单一方法能解决所有任务，且LLM上下文工程在提升性能方面存在局限性。

items.title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
items.summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cach…
